Angular Movement supports Angular `^21.2.0 || ^22.0.0` and works with standalone components, zoneless change detection and server rendering.

## 1. Install the package

:::tabs Package manager

:::tab pnpm

```bash
pnpm add angular-movement
```

:::tab npm

```bash
npm install angular-movement
```

:::tab yarn

```bash
yarn add angular-movement
```

:::

## 2. Optionally register the provider

The defaults are fine for most apps. Use [`provideMovement`](/docs/reference/provide-movement) to override durations or easings once, for the whole application. Numbers are milliseconds.

:::code app.config.ts

```ts
export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideMovement({
      duration: '300ms', // or 300: numbers are milliseconds
      easing: 'ease-out',
    }),
    // prefers-reduced-motion is honoured automatically, no config needed.
  ],
};
```

[View source](https://github.com/Andersseen/angular-movement/blob/main/src/docs-snippets/get-started.ts#L7-L15)

## 3. Import the directive each component uses

Every directive is standalone, so there is nothing else to register. [`MoveEnterDirective`](/docs/reference/move-enter-directive) is the one used here. Everything is imported from `angular-movement`:

:::code imports

```ts
import { MoveEnterDirective, provideMovement } from 'angular-movement';
```

[View source](https://github.com/Andersseen/angular-movement/blob/main/src/docs-snippets/get-started.ts#L3-L3)

:::code welcome.ts

```ts
@Component({
  selector: 'app-welcome',
  imports: [MoveEnterDirective],
  template: `<h1 moveEnter="fade-up">Welcome back</h1>`,
})
export class Welcome {}
```

[View source](https://github.com/Andersseen/angular-movement/blob/main/src/docs-snippets/get-started.ts#L19-L24)

> [!NOTE]
> That is the whole setup: no triggers to declare and no state to manage. The element animates when Angular creates it.

## Try it

Change the settings of the real `moveEnter` directive. Because `moveEnter` plays once when its element is created, each change recreates the element so you can watch the new settings play.

::playground[enter]
